title: Recognizing the classical part
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and let $
u_X^*\dashv
u_{X,*}$ be the comparison adjunction from the small étale site to the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The functor
$
u_X^*\colon\Sh(X_{\Et})	o\Sh(X_{\Proet})$ on sheaves of sets is fully faithful. Its essential image is exactly the classical sheaves of [sk-def-pe-classical-definition].

Let $\Lambda$ be a discrete commutative ring, let $\Lambda_{X,\Et}$ be its constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and write $\Lambda_X=
u_X^*\Lambda_{X,\Et}$. For module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the same inverse image is an exact equivalence between $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and the full subcategory of classical $\Lambda_X$-module sheaves on $X_{\Proet}$, where classicality is as in [sk-def-pe-classical-definition].

proof.text:
Apply [det-pe-classical-sheaves-unit] to the arbitrary scheme $X$. Its statement gives both the invertible unit $F	o
u_{X,*}
u_X^*F$ for every étale sheaf of sets and the bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(F,F')	o\operatorname{Hom}(
u_X^*F,
u_X^*F')$ induced by $
u_X^*$. The latter is exactly full faithfulness of the set-valued inverse image in the first clause.

source.place: First sentence, unit and full faithfulness; detailed sk-thm-pe-classical-sheaves-unit.proof.md, both paragraphs; Stacks Tag 099T, proetale.tex lemma-fully-faithful.

proof.text:
For any sheaf of sets $G$ on $X_{\Proet}$, [det-pe-classical-sheaves-image] identifies membership in the essential image, namely existence of $F$ and an isomorphism $G\cong
u_X^*F$, with bijectivity of every specified continuity map, and with invertibility of the actual counit $
u_X^*
u_{X,*}G	o G$. The definition [sk-def-pe-classical-definition] uses precisely these continuity maps, via [det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map]: for each pro-étale affine presentation $U\cong\varprojlim_{i\in I}U_i$ with its small cofiltered index and affine étale stages, the map $c_{G,(U_i)}$ is induced by restriction, not an arbitrary bijection $\varinjlim_{i\in I^{\mathrm{op}}}G(U_i)\cong G(U)$. Thus (1) and (2) of the cited equivalence give exactly the asserted essential image. In the classical case its condition (3) supplies the canonical representative $F=
u_{X,*}G$ with counit isomorphism.

source.place: First sentence after full faithfulness and the converse/counit paragraph; detailed sk-thm-pe-classical-sheaves-image.proof.md, implications (1) to (2), (2) to (3), (3) to (1); Bhatt–Scholze Lemmas 5.1.1–5.1.2 and Definition 5.1.3, p. 34.

proof.text: Apply [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules] to the given discrete commutative ring $\Lambda$, its constant étale sheaf $\Lambda_{X,\Et}$ and its pullback $\Lambda_X$. These are exactly the coefficients in that statement; no finiteness, torsion, invertibility or noetherian assumption is needed. It supplies the module adjunction and the equivalence onto the full subcategory of classical module sheaves, with quasi-inverse $\nu_{X,*}$. For exactness, if $\Lambda$ is finite, apply the exactness clause of [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level] to $T=X$ and this $\Lambda$; its comparison inverse image is the same functor on these module sheaves. If $\Lambda$ is infinite, use the exactness clause of [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules], whose statement allows every discrete commutative ring. This proves exactness in both cases without extending a finite-ring theorem to infinite rings. The module notion of classicality in [sk-def-pe-classical-definition] is the one used there: the same restriction-induced continuity maps are isomorphisms in $\Lambda$-modules. Consequently the asserted equivalence is exact.

source.place: Last sentence; detailed sk-thm-pe-classical-sheaves-modules.proof.md, all four paragraphs (module structures, exactness, full faithfulness, essential image). The finite-coefficient exactness specialization also realizes the comparison proposition proof, final paragraph, explicitly citing prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level.
